definition.search_prompt: For the refund escalation review, gather the enterprise customer cases from 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30 that are open or pending review, severity at least 2, refund exposure at least $700; the case notes should show legal review, executive visibility, or docs needed.
definition.reference_sql: SELECT sc.case_id, c.customer_name, c.tier, c.industry, sc.opened_date, sc.status, sc.product, sc.severity, ROUND(sc.refund_amount, 2) AS refund_amount, e.employee_name AS owner_name FROM support_cases sc JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sc.customer_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = sc.owner_id WHERE sc.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' AND sc.status IN ('open', 'pending_review') AND c.tier IN ('enterprise') AND sc.severity >= 2 AND sc.refund_amount >= 700 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_notes n WHERE n.case_id = sc.case_id AND n.note_category IN ('legal_review', 'executive_visibility', 'docs_needed') ) ORDER BY sc.case_id
